newsitem.title: USA: Weather shuts Louisiana offshore crude oil port.
newsitem.headline: Weather shuts Louisiana offshore crude oil port.

text.p: Heavy seas and strong winds shut the Louisiana Offshore Oil Port to crude oil deliveries over the weekend, leaving three tankers idled on Sunday, a vessel traffic controller at the facility said.
Known as the LOOP, the facility in the Gulf of Mexico off the Louisiana coast was expected to remain shut through Monday until the rough seas subsided, the controller said.
"We're not pumping any ships due to the seas and strong winds," he said.
The seas were being whipped up not by a tropical depression in the Gulf of Mexico but by a ridge of high pressure along the coast that was generating strong winds offshore, he said.
